{{Quote|If you're in the mood for fish, this seafood slider features a grilled firaxan shark fillet in place of the standard patty, topped with Ahto City cheese, chewy Selkathian seaweed and relish squiggles.|The Dex's Diner menu on the Manaan slider|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''Firaxan shark fillet''' was a type of luxury<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Taking Advantage|[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]}}</ref> meat, considered [[Fish/Legends|seafood]], used in the restaurateur [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]].<ref name="Menu" /> The establishment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was later destroyed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="LOTJ">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref> The fillet was served grilled on his [[Manaan slider]], a [[slider]] inspired by his exploits on the planet of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] that substitued one for the [[Mongo Beefhead patty]] he used in his other slider recipes.<ref name="Menu" /> The fillet was considered a luxury food for milennia, as they were specially flown in from off-world by [[Voontara Fa'athra]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Encounter"/>

==Behind the scenes==
The Firaxan shark fillet is mentioned in a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive release, "[[Dining at Dex's]]" by [[Gregory Walker]], which represents the [[in-universe]] menu of Dex's Diner. Created for ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' ([[2003]]), [[Firaxan shark/Legends|Firaxan sharks]] are [[Water/Legends|sea]] creatures that do [[Canon|exist]] in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Only a nominal connection between them and the fillet is established in Walker's work. The author did intentionally reference myriad aspects of ''Star Wars'' in his work.<ref name="Blog-narbflick|11">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
